candidates.name: Adverse local tissue reaction
support_spans: left buttock and greater trochanteric pain
focal tenderness over the posterior buttock and greater trochanter
left periprosthetic soft‐tissue mass measuring 9 × 8 × 10 cm
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings are consistent with a local tissue reaction around the hip arthroplasty site.

candidates.name: Chronic periprosthetic hip infection
support_spans: persistent buttock pain
decreased and painful range of motion of the left hip
hip aspiration yielded 10,750 white cells/μL
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and laboratory findings suggest a possible chronic infection, although the cultures were negative.

candidates.name: Metallosis
support_spans: ceramic‐on‐ceramic articulation
serum cobalt and chromium levels were within normal limits
candidates.why: The patient's hip arthroplasty has a ceramic-on-ceramic articulation, which can be associated with metallosis, although the serum metal levels were normal.

candidates.name: Osteolysis
support_spans: alkaline phosphatase level of 318 IU/L
left periprosthetic soft‐tissue mass
candidates.why: The patient's elevated alkaline phosphatase level and periprosthetic soft-tissue mass suggest osteolysis, a process of bone resorption.

candidates.name: Periprosthetic hip infection
support_spans: hip aspiration yielded 10,750 white cells/μL
candidates.why: The hip aspiration findings suggest a possible infection, which could be confirmed by further testing.

candidates.name: ALVAL (Adverse Local Tissue Reaction to Metal Debris)
support_spans: left periprosthetic soft‐tissue mass measuring 9 × 8 × 10 cm
candidates.why: The MRI findings of a periprosthetic soft-tissue mass are consistent with ALVAL, which could be confirmed by histopathological examination.
